reason: The selected answer to “Which situation describes the roles and responsibilities for cybersecurity, including coordination of the function?” says that some people perform security tasks but the organization, responsibilities, approval, communication, or personnel list is absent or incomplete. AR-05 confirms the material point and is more specific rather than conflicting: some IT staff perform security tasks informally, but there is no up-to-date list of assigned people. Under GV.RR-02_P2, maintaining such a list and making it known to the competent organizational units are central requirements; the contextual point GV.RR-02_P1 confirms that the personnel are those belonging to the defined and internally communicated cybersecurity organization. AR-05 also states that this organization has not been defined, approved, or communicated internally. ENISA passage V5-ENISA-0004-01 supports interpreting implementation as assigning security responsibilities and authorities to roles, but it does not establish implementation by Aurora Grid. Because AR-05 explicitly establishes the absence of the required current personnel list—and therefore no such list can have been made known—the target is not satisfied.
